data_partition.calibration: GOT-10k validation sequence numeric ID modulo 3 equals 1
data_partition.selection: GOT-10k validation sequence numeric ID modulo 3 equals 2
data_partition.confirmation: GOT-10k validation sequence numeric ID modulo 3 equals 0

mechanism.signal: mean absolute difference between FARTrack's native discrete-coordinate mode and expected-bin coordinate, divided by MODEL.RANGE
mechanism.action: change only the current-frame convex mode/mean output projection; template read/write, state history, search crop, and one frozen network forward remain unchanged
mechanism.host_sync: no scalar item synchronization; projection and gate remain CUDA tensors until the released output coordinate transfer

fixed_alpha_calibration.purpose: endpoint sanity check before adaptive gate fitting

threshold_rule: q0.85 and q0.95 from node14 calibration diagnostic logs only
calibration_selection_rule: highest calibration AO subject to aggregate FPS at least 95% of alpha=0.5 baseline; ties use q0.95 then lower high alpha

selection_gate.run_confirmation_only_if: both AO and FPS requirements are satisfied on selection

b_test_policy: No B_test unless calibration, selection, and confirmation all satisfy the frozen policy gates.
